caption: useradd writes one record to passwd and one to shadow. The passwd record carries UID 1500 and primary GID 2000. The shadow record gets a locked placeholder, and a real hash is written only later by passwd. Group records and supplementary memberships are handled separately by groupadd and usermod.

spec.title: Account files written by useradd

nodes.label: /etc/group
nodes.note: students GID 2000; members updated later by usermod

spec.aria: A root administrator runs useradd, which writes a user record with UID 1500 and primary GID 2000 to /etc/passwd and a locked password placeholder to /etc/shadow (a real hash is written only later by passwd). Group records are created separately by groupadd, and usermod -aG updates member lists later.
